name: Ren
source:
A young "Mushitsukai" and scion of the village head, whose entire life has been devoted to mastering the control of insects.

He's usually cool-headed and highly proficient, but due to a certain incident, he lost the ability to feel any pain. As a result, he became more fearless and sometimes needlessly reckless with his own body. 

[Spoiler]Because he cannot feel pain, outsiders often perceive him as unusually cruel or sadistic, though this is far from the truth.

He’s also [url=/c14599]Yumemi’s[/url] mysterious benefactor, whom she jokingly calls "Daddy-Long-Legs".[/spoiler] 

[Based on the [url=https://www.cyc-soft.com/b-cyc-pro/extra/cha/extra_cha_02_3_1.htm]official description[/url]]
